E.headline: Scaling and post-training help False Belief performance but not strictly; the explicit-versus-implicit cue crossover shows performance is not robust, and it emerges during pre-training.

G.notes: Main analyses pool 17-18 models (Table 2 lists 18 family-size cells, text says 17) with a family random intercept, so per-model results exist only for OLMo 2 (Table 1, Figs. 4-5); E has OLMo 2 rows only. Human reference is a single published figure. No own code release; the OSF link is to the source stimuli. BLiMP comparison and steering vectors are outside the paradigm count.
